story.titleZh: 佩雷斯从第15位进站，虽然比赛表现不错但进站速度慢

relatedItems.titleZh: 勒克莱尔也将使用新引擎，法拉利车队本周末更换动力单元
relatedItems.summaryZh: 勒克莱尔和法拉利车队本周末将使用新的内燃机，同时佩雷斯在凯迪拉克车队也将更换新的动力单元。
relatedItems.originalTitle: You can add Leclerc to this as well. Both Ferraris taking new internal combustion engines this weekend Also a new PU for Perez at Cadillac #F1
relatedItems.summaryEn:
You can add Leclerc to this as well. Both Ferraris taking new internal combustion engines this weekend
Also a new PU for Perez at Cadillac #F1Chris Medland: Understand power unit penalties for both Verstappen and Hamilton incoming - think Max will have the bigger penalty. Could be others too #F1 #BrazilGP
detailZh:
你也可以把勒克莱尔加上。本周末两辆法拉利都使用了新的内燃机
佩雷斯在凯迪拉克也使用了新的动力单元 #F1Chris Medland：了解即将到来的动力单元处罚，我认为马克斯将会受到更大的处罚。也可能会有其他人受到影响 #F1 #巴西大奖赛
detailEn:

relatedItems.summaryZh: 胡肯博格在FP2练习中缺席，奥迪车队正在努力找出赛车在FP1练习中因疑似电气问题而停车的故障原因。

relatedItems.summaryEn: No Hulkenberg in FP2 as Audi continues trying to identify the cause of a suspected electrical issue on the car that stopped it in FP1 when Slater was driving #F1 #BrazilGP
detailZh: FP2没有胡尔肯伯格，奥迪车队继续试图找出导致赛车在FP1中因疑似电气问题而停止的原因，当时斯莱特正在驾驶#F1 #巴西大奖赛
detailEn: No Hulkenberg in FP2 as Audi continues trying to identify the cause of a suspected electrical issue on the car that stopped it in FP1 when Slater was driving #F1 #BrazilGP
